source_summary: Wide horizontal Chinese landscape with lake and distant hills, rocky foreground, arched bridge, cliff gate, thatched riverside pavilion with figures, overhanging pine foliage, and a dark right-hand cliff.

motifs.name: misty_distant_mountain_band
motifs.description: Isolate the pale blue-gray distant mountain chain and low shoreline silhouettes across the upper middle distance, including soft washes and faint horizontal water haze beneath them.

motifs.name: left_foreground_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the dark and pale foreground rocks at the lower left, with the sloping bank and sparse shrubs, excluding nearby inscriptions and seals.

motifs.name: arched_footbridge_over_water
motifs.description: Isolate the small arched wooden bridge spanning the narrow water channel, including its rail posts and the circular ripples below.
must_preserve: delicate ink wash on bridge deck

motifs.name: central_cliff_gate_path
motifs.description: Isolate the pale jagged cliff wall and narrow wooden gate or fence leading toward the pavilion compound, including the path edge and rock textures.
must_preserve: small water-edge marks at the base

motifs.name: thatched_pavilion_study
motifs.description: Isolate the main thatched pavilion with open study room, lattice panels, stone foundation, and seated scholar at a table inside.
must_preserve: subtle red and blue garment accents

motifs.name: right_garden_attendant
motifs.description: Isolate the standing attendant or servant figure near the pavilion garden, holding a broom or rake beside low shrubs.

motifs.name: overhanging_pine_canopy
motifs.description: Isolate the sweeping upper-right pine canopy with gnarled branches and dense needle clusters above the pavilion, avoiding seals and text.

motifs.name: right_dark_cliff_face
motifs.description: Isolate the massive dark rock cliff on the far right with pale streaks, angular facets, and adjoining root-like tree forms, excluding seals at the image edge.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
